name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively maintained with frequent patch releases across multiple stable branches. The latest release is v0.63.17 (open source) / v1.63.17 (enterprise), released on September 10, 2025. Multiple version branches (v0.58.x through v0.63.x) are being simultaneously maintained with patch updates. Detailed per-release changelogs are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases but individual change details were not included in the provided changelog text.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across several version branches as recently as September 10, 2025.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, SQL Server, Presto, Druid, Oracle, Vertica, Spark SQL, and more via drivers; specific connector changes not detailed in this changelog excerpt.

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers best-in-class visualizations and enterprise features but is expensive and closed-source compared to Metabase.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash integrates natively with dbt for a metrics-first approach, making it more structured than Metabase but requiring dbt adoption.
